After a couple adopts a pair of orphaned brothers, it becomes alarmingly clear the boys are much more than they seem. Hypnotizing schoolmates and destroying any adult opposition, the frightening campaign of terror that began in Children of the Corn continues.

When the Doyle family moves to a small town to start a new life, they take over the long-abandoned Fowler Funeral Home and cemetery. The locals fear the place, and the grounds are rumored to be haunted. All too soon, the Doyles discover the stories are true.

Dr. Alice Dodgson (Jennifer Grey) travels to Jamaica to treat the mysteriously ailing brother of an American.
